# DJ Amithigh (גיא אמיתי / Guy Amithigh)

> DJ for weddings and business events in Israel, based in Tel Aviv. די ג'יי לחתונות ולאירועים עסקיים, מנגן בכל הארץ. Hebrew and English.

## Quick facts
- Services: wedding DJ, business event DJ, private and boutique event DJ
- Experience: 200+ weddings
- Base: Tel Aviv. Plays all over Israel.
- Styles: mainstream, house, techno, disco, Greek, Latin, reggaeton, 90s and 2000s
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +972-52-535-3259, email 972event@gmail.com
- Check a date: message on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/972525353259) with date and location
- Pricing: by date, location and event type; website discount; no public price list
